scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Oak Hollow battery-module delivery from creating an avoidable overnight storage hazard before Friday's rooftop set.
Emerging Need: A normal receiving plan becomes risky only after freight timing, an elevator conflict, an exterior-cage fallback, and a heat advisory align.
Decision Context: Early delivery notices do not justify disruption; later updates leave a brief reversible window, with the safe alternate location and access path available only in shared compliance records.
Consequence: If the window closes without a storage-plan adjustment, sealed modules may sit through morning heat in an unsuitable exterior cage before installation begins.

parameter.title: Oak Hollow battery cabinet delivery and roof set
parameter.description: Battery module cartons and cabinet hardware scheduled for receiving ahead of the11:00 rooftop set; roof crew security check-in is10:30. Receiving plan to be confirmed the day before.
parameter.location: Oak Hollow School service dock and roof access

parameter.subject: Oak Hollow battery modules shipping confirmation
parameter.body: The battery-module cartons left Greensboro this morning. Carrier appointment is requested for 14:00 today at Oak Hollow receiving. Cartons remain sealed; the driver will call receiving if the appointment changes.

parameter.content: Oak Hollow receiving just told me the freight elevator is reserved for cafeteria equipment from 14:00 to 15:45. If the battery pallet lands during that block, general receiving will put it in the covered west cage until tomorrow morning's roof set.

parameter.subject: Friday heat advisory: exterior storage areas
parameter.body: Facilities is circulating tomorrow's heat advisory for Oak Hollow. Forecast heat index is 103-106 from late morning onward, and the west asphalt storage cage is expected to exceed 95°F by 09:00. Please keep temperature-sensitive sealed equipment indoors when possible.

parameter.subject: Delay update: Oak Hollow battery pallet
parameter.body: Driver is now expected at Oak Hollow receiving at 16:05. Receiving closes at 16:30. Unless the site updates dock instructions before 15:55, the delivery will be unloaded to the west cage under standard receiving. Roof freight access and escort service end at15:45 today and resume at10:30 tomorrow; the later arrival cannot go directly upstairs. An approved ground-floor alternative can still be entered in the dock instructions before15:55.

parameter.content: Receiving says the dock-instruction log closed at 16:00, and the driver has checked in. The pallet is being locked into the west cage; district security will not escort equipment moves again until the roof crew check-in at 10:30 tomorrow.
